# Toggle group (`toggle-group`)

Icon or text toggles, single or multiple.

Group: Choice & range. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/choice-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createToggleGroup` (types in `dist/web/choice-inputs/toggleGroup.d.ts`): `.mh-toggle-group` (`role="group"`): a row of `.mh-toggle-group__item` toggle buttons (`aria-pressed`) with text, an icon or both, for formatting-style choices such as which days or which zones. One Tab stop: arrow keys, Home and End move between toggles, Space or Enter presses. `single` keeps at most one pressed (and with `required`, exactly one); `multiple` any number.

```ts
export function createToggleGroup(options: ToggleGroupOptions): ToggleGroupHandle;

export interface ToggleGroupOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the group. */
  label: string;
  options: readonly ToggleOption[];
  /** `single`: at most one pressed (pressing another moves it). `multiple`: any number. Default `multiple`. */
  type?: ToggleGroupType;
  /** The pressed values. */
  values?: readonly string[];
  /** `single` only: one stays pressed (pressing it again does nothing). */
  required?: boolean;
  size?: 'small' | 'medium';
  /** Stretch to the container, toggles sharing the width. */
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onChange?: (values: string[], event: Event) => void;
}

export interface ToggleGroupHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  buttons: HTMLButtonElement[];
  getValues(): string[];
  setValues(values: readonly string[]): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createToggleGroup } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const days = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
const status = document.createElement('p');

const repeat = createToggleGroup({
  label: 'Repeat on',
  type: 'multiple',
  values: ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri'],
  options: days.map((day) => ({ value: day, label: day })),
  onChange: (values) => (status.textContent = values.length ? `Repeats on ${values.join(', ')}` : 'Runs once'),
});

document.body.append(repeat.el, status);
```

## React API

`ToggleGroup` (types in `dist/react/choice-inputs.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createToggleGroup`; controlled by `values` (or uncontrolled with `defaultValues`).

```ts
export function ToggleGroup({ label, options, type = 'multiple', values, defaultValues, required, size, fullWidth, disabled = false, className, onChange }: ToggleGroupProps);

export interface ToggleGroupProps {
  /** Accessible name of the group. */
  label: string;
  options: readonly ToggleOption[];
  type?: ToggleGroupType;
  values?: readonly string[];
  defaultValues?: readonly string[];
  required?: boolean;
  size?: 'small' | 'medium';
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  onChange?: (values: string[]) => void;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ToggleGroup } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const DAYS = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'].map((day) => ({ value: day, label: day }));

export function ToggleGroupExample() {
  const [days, setDays] = useState(['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri']);
  return <ToggleGroup label="Repeat on" type="multiple" options={DAYS} values={days} onChange={setDays} />;
}
```
